info.name: NileShopping API v2 (GraphQL + REST)
info.description:
## NileShopping Mobile API

Includes all REST endpoints **and** the Lighthouse GraphQL home screen APIs.

### Quick Start
1. Import the companion **NileShopping – Local** environment and select it.
2. Run **Auth → Signin (Phone — Mobile)** with your phone number — the JWT is auto-saved to `{{AUTH_TOKEN}}`.
3. Every GraphQL request in the **GraphQL – Home Screen** folder is ready to fire.

### GraphQL Endpoint
`POST {{BASE_URL}}/api/graphql`

### Authentication
All APIs (REST and GraphQL) use a JWT Bearer token.  `Authorization: Bearer {{AUTH_TOKEN}}`

### Environment Variables
| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `BASE_URL` | e.g. `http://localhost/nileShopping/public` |
| `AUTH_TOKEN` | JWT — auto-captured from login response |

item.name: GraphQL – Home Screen
item.description:
## Home Screen GraphQL APIs

Endpoint: `POST {{BASE_URL}}/api/graphql`

All requests send the GraphQL query as JSON: `{ "query": "...", "variables": {...} }`

Authentication is enforced server-side via the `@guard(with: ["api"])` directive.
Pass your JWT in the `Authorization: Bearer {{AUTH_TOKEN}}` header (inherited from collection).

request.description:
## Best Selling Products – View More

Paginated listing. Change `page` to load next results. Ordered by completed order count descending.

### Variables
| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `section` | `SectionType!` | Always `BEST_SELLING` for this request |
| `first` | `Int!` | Items per page (default 10) |
| `page` | `Int!` | Page number (1-based) |

### Pagination
Use `paginatorInfo.hasMorePages` to decide whether to show the "Load More" button.
`paginatorInfo.lastPage` gives the total number of pages.
Paginated trending products ordered by wishlist count + recency.
Paginated newest products ordered by `listings.created_at` descending.
Products from categories whose name or slug contains 'accessor'.
Products viewed by the authenticated user, ordered by most-recently-viewed. Populates automatically when the user opens a product detail via `GET /api/product/detail`.
All products priced between ₹99 and ₹500, paginated.

Paginated products by specific category ID. Used when user taps 'View All' on a sub-category chip.

**Note**: `categoryId` is the `menus.id` value returned from the `gendersAndCategories` section.

item.name: Recently Viewed APIs
item.description: Recently viewed products are tracked automatically when users open product detail. Query them via GraphQL.

request.description:
Returns the last 10 products viewed by the authenticated user, most-recent first.

**How views are tracked**: Calling `GET /api/product/detail?product_id=X` automatically upserts a row in `recently_viewed`. No separate tracking call required.

item.name: Trigger a Product View (to populate recently viewed)

request.description: Open any product detail to add it to `recently_viewed`. Then call the GraphQL Recently Viewed query to confirm the section populates.
